title: 第11章 第一张符箓第12章 这才叫挂
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
半小时后，苏醒在自己的房间里，注视着铺满各处的淡黄色符纸。
空气中仍残留着姜黄的辛香，饥饿感像只小兽，在他胃里轻轻抓挠，但他并未理会。
他等的不仅仅是纸张干透，更是一个态度，一个来自和平饭店高层的、关于此前冲突的明确回应。
就在这时，一阵克制而清晰的敲门声响起——笃，笃笃。
苏醒眼神微动，不慌不忙地站起身，动作细致地将房间里几乎干透的符纸
一一收起，叠放整齐，才缓步走到门边，打开了房门。
门外站着两个人。
为首的正是助理罗璇轩，他依旧是一身笔挺的制服，表情带着恰到好处的歉意与郑重。
而在他身后侧，则是一位身着洁白厨师服的年轻人，双手稳稳托着一个宽大的餐盘。
餐盘之上罩着一个闪亮的银质餐盖，诱人的食物香气正丝丝缕缕地从缝隙中逸散出来，勾得人食欲大动。
“苏先生，”
罗璇轩微微躬身，语气诚恳，“实在抱歉，这是我的工作没有做到位，让您烦心了。”
他直起身，继续道：“您提及的杨永信，以及他的两位叔伯和一位婶婶，我们已经依据饭店规章，予以全部清退。
您之后在和平饭店内，绝不会再见到他们。”
说完，他侧身示意了一下身旁厨师手中的托盘。
“另外，听闻您还未用晚餐，我特意让后厨为您重新准备了一份。
希望这份小小的歉意，您能接受。”
苏醒目光在餐盘和罗璇轩真诚的脸上扫过，随即伸手亲自接过了那个沉甸甸的大餐盘，脸上露出受宠若惊又略带歉然的笑容：
“罗助理您这话言重了，怪我太小家子气了，倒劳您亲自跑一趟，真是让我…怪不好意思的。”
“哪里哪里，这主要是我的工作没有做好，我……”

两人在苏醒的房门外寒暄了片刻，罗璇轩拒绝了苏醒入门的邀请，告辞离开。
这就是天赋带来的特权，曾经霸凌自己的人，只是因为自己一句话，不仅自己丢了工作，连带全家都丢了工作，这就是现实世界的规则。
吃完饭后，苏醒迫不及待地来到书桌前，铺开特制的姜黄符纸，打开那瓶暗红色的魔狼血朱砂墨，用新得的狼毫笔饱蘸浓墨。
他凝神静气，脑海中《天机符箓大全册》缓缓展开，【文昌符】的完整画法如同流水般自然呈现。
苏醒前世在道观中画过无数文昌符，本以为此次必定手到擒来，一气呵成，却没想到遭遇了意想不到的困难。
不知是因职业规则系统的约束，还是因为此方天地的大道至理所需，【文昌符】的画法与他前世所知竟有三成不同。
最棘手的是，这些修改并非全盘推翻，而是局部调整，这让他固有的画符记忆和习惯成了最大障碍。
新人学符如白纸作画，而他则需在已经写满字的纸上重新书写，难度倍增。
整整一晚上，苏醒废寝忘食地绘制了七十多张符箓，竟无一成功。
精力几近枯竭的他，最终只得将问题暂且搁置，蒙头睡去，将难题留给明天的自己。
翌日清晨，苏醒早早起床，仔细洗漱，简单用过早餐后，还特意外出慢跑一公里。
回到宿舍，他盘膝坐在窗边，任由清晨温暖的阳光洒在脸上，放空思绪，进入一种澄澈的静思状态。
突然，他双眼睁开，眸中精光一闪。
起身、行至桌前、铺纸、提笔、蘸墨，动作行云流水，毫无滞涩。
content_en:
Half an hour later, he woke up in his room, staring at the light yellow talismans spread everywhere.
The spicy scent of turmeric still lingered in the air, and the feeling of hunger was like a small animal, scratching gently in his stomach, but he ignored it.
What he was waiting for was not only for the paper to dry, but also for an attitude, a clear response from the top management of the Peace Hotel regarding the previous conflict.
At this moment, there was a restrained and clear knock on the door - beep, beep, beep.
Su Xing's eyes moved slightly, he stood up unhurriedly, and carefully removed the almost dry talisman paper in the room.
After putting them away one by one and stacking them neatly, he slowly walked to the door and opened it.
There were two people standing outside the door.
The leader was the assistant Luo Xuanxuan. He was still wearing a straight uniform and his expression was appropriately apologetic and solemn.
Behind him, there was a young man wearing a white chef's uniform, holding a large dinner plate firmly with both hands.
The dinner plate is covered with a shiny silver lid, and the tempting aroma of food is escaping from the gaps, whetting people's appetite.
"Mr. Su,"
Luo Xuanxuan bowed slightly and said in a sincere tone, "I'm really sorry. It's because I didn't do my job well and it bothered you."
He straightened up and continued: "We have dismissed the Yang Yongxin you mentioned, as well as his two uncles and an aunt, in accordance with hotel regulations.
You will never see them again at the Peace Hotel. "
After speaking, he gestured sideways to the tray in the hands of the chef next to him.
"In addition, I heard that you haven't had dinner yet, so I asked the chef to prepare a new one for you.
I hope you can accept this small apology. "
Su Xing glanced at the dinner plate and Luo Xuanxuan's sincere face, then reached out and took the heavy dinner plate personally, with a flattered and slightly apologetic smile on his face:
"Assistant Luo, what you said is too serious. You blame me for being too petty. I feel sorry for you to go there in person."
"No, no, this is mainly because I didn't do my job well, I..."
The two of them chatted for a while outside Su Xing's room. Luo Xuanxuan refused Su Xing's invitation and said goodbye.
This is the privilege brought by talent. People who once bullied themselves not only lost their jobs, but also their whole family's jobs just because of their own words. This is the rule of the real world.
After finishing the meal, Su Xing couldn't wait to come to the desk, spread out the special turmeric talisman paper, opened the bottle of dark red Demonic Wolf Blood Cinnabar Ink, and dipped his newly acquired wolf-hair brush into the thick ink.
He concentrated and calmed down, and the "Complete Collection of Tianji Talisman" slowly unfolded in his mind, and the complete painting method of "Wenchang Talisman" appeared as naturally as flowing water.
Su Xing had drawn numerous Wenchang talismans in Taoist temples in his previous life. He thought he would be able to do it this time, but he did not expect to encounter unexpected difficulties.
I don't know whether it is due to the constraints of the professional rule system or the need for the great principles of this world, but the painting method of [Wenchang Talisman] is 30% different from what he knew in his previous life.
The most troublesome thing is that these modifications are not total overthrows, but partial adjustments, which makes his inherent memory and habits of drawing symbols the biggest obstacle.
Learning talismans for a newcomer is like drawing on a blank piece of paper, while he needs to rewrite on the paper that is already full of words, doubling the difficulty.
For a whole night, Su Xing spent all his time drawing more than seventy talismans, but none of them were successful.
With his energy almost exhausted, he finally had to put the problem aside for the time being, cover his head and fall asleep, leaving the problems to himself tomorrow.
The next morning, Su Xing got up early, washed carefully, had a simple breakfast, and even went out for a one-kilometer jog.
Returning to his dormitory, he sat cross-legged by the window, letting the warm morning sunshine shine on his face, letting his thoughts go, and entering a clear state of meditation.
Suddenly, his eyes opened and a light flashed in his eyes.
Get up, walk to the table, spread the paper, pick up the pen, dip in ink, and moveMake flowing clouds and flowing water without any stagnation.
